statement: Implement LSTM and GRU: implement recurrent gates and compare LSTM and GRU TinyShakespeare bits per character. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use tinyshakespeare; required output: [N,T] tokens -> [N,T,V] logits. Evaluate bpc (minimize). Reset/detach recurrent state at declared boundaries; GRU paper is a separate citation. Required ablation: Replace gated recurrence with a tanh Elman cell at matched parameter count. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
